name: What should I prepare before discussing a new kitchen layout with a contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before discussing a new kitchen layout with a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a kitchen remodeling contractor, document your current pain points and gather basic measurements of the room footprint. Take photos of your existing setup, note where family traffic bottlenecks occur, and list appliances you want to keep, upgrade, or add. Measure the overall wall lengths, ceiling height, and the placement of exterior windows. You should also verify what sits beneath your kitchen floor, such as an unfinished basement, finished ceiling, or concrete slab, because subfloor access directly affects how easily utilities can be shifted.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your daily traffic bottlenecks, measure your wall lengths and ceiling heights, note desired appliances, and check whether your subfloor is easily accessible from below.
